newsitem.title: UK: EMI Group down after director sells shares.
newsitem.headline: EMI Group down after director sells shares.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc fell on Friday after a large block of shares was sold by one of the company's directors, dealers said.
The shares reached their lowest level since the demerger of the company's Thorn retail interests in August.
By 1030 GMT, the shares were down 15-1/2p at 13.00-1/2 stg, adding to yesterday's 15p decline as analysts shaved earnings forecasts for the music publishing group.
"The story today is that the finance director sold a lot of shares last night," one leisure analyst told Reuters.
Director Simon Duffy sold 135,000 of his EMI shares at a price of 13.18 stg, according to a statement issued on Thursday.
